verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents the Brewfile and `brew bundle install`, which install a project's declared dependencies from a file. Nothing in the evidence shows a lockfile that records exact resolved versions, or any guarantee of identical versions across machines. `brew bundle dump` snapshots which packages are installed, not their pinned versions. Community reports of being unable to pin upgrades and of missing Nix's reproducibility fit this gap. The Brewfile is an adjacent manifest feature, not version-locked reproducible installs.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install dependencies from a lockfile and get the exact same resolved versions on every machine
